Yes — I added task comments with persistence.

What changed:
- Added backend endpoints to:
  - list comments for a task
  - add a new comment to a task
- Kept comments tied to the authenticated user and task
- Added frontend API helpers for comments
- Updated the task route logic to support comment lookup/creation
- Extended the in-memory test mock to handle comment storage
- Kept the existing app tests passing

Note: I didn’t add the UI for viewing/adding comments in the task screen yet, so the API is ready but the dashboard still won’t show comments until the frontend is updated. If you want, I can add the comment panel/modal next.
